features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you establish a telepathic bond with a creature you can see for (Sorcerer level × 10) minutes.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.desc: You can cast your subclass's Psionic spells by spending Sorcery Points instead of spell slots; subtly (without components).

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.desc: As a Bonus Action and for Sorcery Points, you gain flight, swimming and underwater breathing, the ability to see Invisible creatures, or flexibility (squeezing through tight spaces).

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.desc: For 5 Sorcery Points, as an action you teleport up to 120 feet; creatures near your departure point take Force damage.
